Real demand is present but fading, and the desk's base rates argue against buying into a dip on unconfirmed structure.
memos.skeptic: The most likely loss is a slow bleed from distribution plus fees. In the last 15 minutes, 289.26 SOL was sold against 289.66 bought (net flow +0.4 SOL), with 613 sellers against 736 buyers, so demand is barely covering exits. The coin is already 38.9% off its 30-minute high despite a +26.9% 30-minute return, which looks like a fading peak rather than a base. The first two minutes show a 0.86 sell-to-buy ratio, a launch bot present, and only 100 SOL of pool depth, so impact on a $20 ticket is meaningful. Name and symbol are null and the curve fields are unknown, so there is no evidence of operator backing. At a 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost, a small bounce won't cover fees. Skip.
